title: Nexus AI — Leakage Ablation, GMM Sanity Check & 70/30 Cross-Validation
selection_rule: Selection rule applied on Set B: Internal metrics (Davies-Bouldin, Calinski-Harabasz, Silhouette) + Stability (Test ARI) + Noise % first; agreement with node-type labels second.
chosen_feature_set: Set B (8 structural features: degree, weighted_degree, pagerank, core_number, clustering_coeff, betweenness, eigenvector, avg_neighbor_degree)

spectral_stability_collapse.statement: Spectral clustering stability = 1.0 in prior runs was an artifact of degenerate cluster collapse.
spectral_stability_collapse.explanation: Cluster 0 contains 2181 of 2258 nodes (96.59%). Because over 96% of points belong to a single mass, random subsamples trivially match on the dominant cluster, giving artificially high ARI.

dbscan_noise_betweenness.statement: DBSCAN noise nodes have significantly higher betweenness centrality than average.
dbscan_noise_betweenness.explanation: DBSCAN noise nodes have a mean betweenness of 0.027198, which is 17.94x higher than the overall dataset mean (0.001516) and 90.36x higher than non-noise nodes (0.000301). DBSCAN treats sparse inter-cluster bridge nodes as noise due to lack of local density.
